project_info.theme: Techcombank Visa Eco x Grab transportation discount offer
project_info.color_palette: Light blue, white, black, bright red, Grab green, eco green

main_subject.detail: A co-branded discount poster with a smiling GrabBike driver in green uniform and helmet seated on a black motorbike, while a young woman passenger in white top and beige skirt sits behind him and stretches a Techcombank Visa Eco card toward the viewer. The headline reads 'Tang ban toi 50% khi su dung the thanh toan Techcombank Visa Eco'. Two large coupon boxes say 'GrabBike Giam 8K cho chuyen di tu 15K' and 'GrabCarEV Giam 15K cho chuyen di tu 30K'. A green GrabCar is shown on the road in the background. Bottom-left footnote reads '(*) Ap dung cac diem di va diem den tai Metro va ban kinh xung quanh trong pham vi 100m'.
main_subject.style: Clean lifestyle-promotion composite with real people, transport branding, and soft futuristic road backdrop

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for a Techcombank Visa Eco and Grab transportation discount campaign. Centerpiece is a smiling GrabBike driver in green uniform riding a black scooter with a young woman passenger behind him, while she holds a green Techcombank Visa Eco card toward the viewer. Background is a soft futuristic road scene with a city skyline and a green GrabCar on the right. Surrounding elements: Grab logo, Techcombank logo, exact headline 'Tang ban toi 50% khi su dung the thanh toan Techcombank Visa Eco', two coupon boxes reading 'GrabBike Giam 8K cho chuyen di tu 15K' and 'GrabCarEV Giam 15K cho chuyen di tu 30K', and the exact footnote '(*) Ap dung cac diem di va diem den tai Metro va ban kinh xung quanh trong pham vi 100m'. Technical style: photoreal promotional compositing for co-branded transport advertising, bright lifestyle commercial lighting, subtle speed-light trails and airy mobility-campaign atmosphere, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
